commentary: Nifty's decisive reclaim of the 25,000 milestone on explosive institutional buying confirms an ongoing Stage 2 market uptrend under Stan Weinstein's model. However, O'Neil market-direction discipline demands caution: breadth stands at a selective 52%, revealing a marked divergence between heavyweight leaders and vulnerable broader-market segments. In CANSLIM methodology, market follow-throughs without uniform breadth expansion require progressive exposure rather than reckless aggression. We trade exclusively confirmed Stage 2 leaders showing true earnings acceleration and tight pivot structures, while honoring Minervini-style risk parameters. Until smallcap and midcap participation synchronizes with headline benchmark momentum, maintain tight stop discipline, avoid chasing extended breakouts, and keep risk per trade strictly asymmetric.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis, Darvas Box & Livermore Discipline

360ONE.technical: Cleared a 20-day consolidation high on 2.25x volume with RSI at 59, reflecting constructive institutional accumulation. Price action holds comfortably above the 21-day EMA and 50-day SMA, confirming an orderly Stage 2 advance out of a shallow base without overextension.
360ONE.fundamental: Operating margins remain robust at 59% with wealth ARR AUM advancing 24% YoY, but MTM volatility restrained quarterly earnings. TTM ROCE sits near 12% with clean balance-sheet leverage, though top-line growth of 4% misses strict CANSLIM high-acceleration benchmarks.
360ONE.risk: Thesis fails if price breaks below the 1142.82 pivot floor, breaching short-term swing support and mandating an immediate exit.

63MOONS.technical: Forming a classic double bottom with neckline resistance at 982.83. Alignment above the 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA signals base completion and early Stage 2 transition, though volume conviction on the pivot attempt requires further institutional confirmation.
63MOONS.fundamental: ODIN platform provides a sticky trading franchise and virtually debt-free balance sheet, but net profitability contracted YoY (-10% in Q2, -82% in Q1). Poor 3-year ROE of 1.5% and reliance on other income violate CANSLIM earnings-quality standards.
63MOONS.risk: Break below 883.03 invalidates the double-bottom base structure and breaches key moving averages, triggering strict stop execution.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Executing a clean 20-day breakout at 416.87 after finding support at the rising 21-EMA. RSI at 58 shows healthy momentum with no extension, confirming strong Stage 2 leadership as price trades well above the 50-day and 200-day moving averages.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Delivered stellar 38% YoY net profit growth with revenue rising 32%, driven by NBFC profitability crossing 1,000 crore and credit costs dropping to seven-year lows of 92 bps. Broad-based lending growth and improving operating leverage support genuine CANSLIM leadership.
ABCAPITAL.risk: A close below 391.17 violates the rising 21-EMA support and breakout pivot, demanding an immediate stop loss to protect capital.

ABSLNN50ET.technical: Pushed past a 20-session consolidation high at 79.51 on 1.26x volume with RSI at 66. Trading well above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, reflecting broad Stage 2 accumulation across the Nifty Next 50 basket.
ABSLNN50ET.risk: A break below 76.15 breaches key swing support and the 21-day EMA, signaling base failure and enforcing an immediate exit.

ADANIENSOL.technical: Logged a decisive 20-day breakout at 1673.67, comfortably clearing its base. Price holds firmly above its 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA with RSI 60 and positive MACD, confirming strong Stage 2 momentum and relative strength.
ADANIENSOL.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM credentials with Q2 net profit leaping 145% YoY and revenue surging 53%, driven by smart meter contracts and operational transmission expansion. Operating EBITDA grew 68%, though heavy capital spending and high debt require vigilant monitoring.
ADANIENSOL.risk: A decline below 1575.77 violates the breakout base and key moving averages, triggering an immediate stop-out.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Cleared its 20-day range at 1417.42 with RSI at 63 and positive MACD. Trading constructively above upward-sloping 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, indicating healthy Stage 2 structure, though volume expansion remains moderate.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Operational capacity reached 20.8 GW with power supply revenue surging 42% and EBITDA margins topping 90%. However, substantial finance costs softened net profit expansion to 16%, and elevated debt-to-EBITDA (5.6x) restrains fundamental CANSLIM qualification.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Breaching the 1326.34 stop level invalidates the 20-day pivot and fractures short-term moving average support.
